Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

tasty — having a good taste. Example: It is a tasty dish.
sweet — having the taste of sugar. Example: The dessert is very sweet.
salty — containing too much salt. Example: The soup is a little salty.
spicy — having a strong hot taste. Example: The chicken is spicy.
sour — having a sharp taste like lemon. Example: The lemon is sour.
fresh — recent and not old. Example: The salad is fresh.
delicious — very good to eat. Example: The soup is delicious.
dish — food prepared in a particular way. Example: My favourite dish is spicy chicken.
recipe — the instructions for cooking a dish. Example: This is a simple recipe.
ingredient — one of the foods in a recipe. Example: The ingredients are simple.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• It is delicious.
• It is too salty.
• It is very sweet.
• It is spicy but tasty.
• What is in this dish?

Grammar focus: Adjectives for taste.
Use adjectives after be or before the noun to describe taste: The soup is salty. It is a delicious dish. Link two adjectives with and: It is sweet and fresh.
